name: geldmacher-workflow
description: Plan, implement, review, and refine changes with your coding agent. Commission each step yourself, or use Auto-Work for a sequence with independent review and bounded correction rounds.

interface.shortDescription: Clear plans and reviewed results for AI coding.
interface.longDescription: Plan, implement, review, and refine changes with your coding agent. Commission each step yourself, or use Auto-Work for a sequence with independent review and bounded correction rounds.
defaultPrompt: Use $plan-work to turn my goal into an actionable implementation plan.
Use $review-work to check the current changes against the plan and explain what remains open.
Use $work-status to explain what is done and what needs attention.
Use $auto-work light to plan and implement my goal, with independent review and at most three correction rounds.
